name: newsh2-159
summary: Bronze pod (newsh2 frames 159-167): a round bronze ball, as tall as it is wide, with a steel band strapped round it across its upper half, a short square post on top, and a dark bay below the band holding a small steel pod. Over the frames thin arms telescope out of the band's ends and red-hot fins open round them. Shape language: a smooth round metal ball (round) carrying hard-surface parts (flat bevelled strap, squarish post, a capsule pod sunk in a cut-in bay).

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: round outline matching the sprite's circle (columns 4-19, rows 6-22)
round in every section, about as tall as it is wide (~7.5 px half height)
one bronze mid-tone; the light makes the shading, no painted dark rim ring
features.note: The body of the enemy. Must read as a ball, not a lens or slab.

traits: straight grey strap across the full width, rows 11-14 (4 px wide)
flat outer face with bevelled edges (hard surface), wrapping round the ball
stands about 1.5 px proud of the ball, sitting in a groove; not a tall handle arch
polished steel: the sprite's white spots on it are sheen
features.note: The concept draws it as a riveted steel strap round the ball. The first fix rounds made it a round tube arching 3 px over the crown, which read as a kettle handle.

traits: a dark rounded-rectangle bay cut into the ball under the band, columns 9-14, rows 14-18
a dark steel capsule pod lying along the bay (columns 10-13), its top below the rim
reads dark from above, with the pod visible in it
features.note: The sprite's dark mix of grey and dark-brown pixels; the concept reads it as a steel pod in a recess. The baseline had a flat dark slab here.

traits: short squarish post on the ball's front crown, columns 9-14, rows 6-9
upright, about 8 px tall, darker bronze with a flat bevelled top
a dark gap (row 10) between it and the band
features.note: The concept draws it as a boxy armoured block with a cap.

traits: darker grey stubs at both ends of the band, on the outline
thin arms slide out a pixel a side per frame (tips 8 to 12 px from centre)
features.note: The animated telescoping arms; in frame 159 only the ends show.

traits: a tan rib down the left flank beside the bay (columns 6-7, rows 15-18)
a darker bronze patch on the right flank (columns 17-18, rows 15-17)
painted markings on the ball, not bumps
features.note: The concept reads these as the edges of armour plates either side of the bay.

traits: frames 163-167 only: red-hot fins opening round the arms outside the ball's sides
glowing (emissive) red
features.note: Not visible in frame 159 (the sheet's frame).
